title: Portfolio State Updated Event
description: Schema for EVT:PORTFOLIO_STATE_UPDATED event payload describing complete portfolio state

ts.description: Timestamp of portfolio state snapshot in milliseconds

equity.description: Current equity/capital value in USD (string-encoded Decimal for precision)

equity_free_usdt.description: Available equity in USDT (string-encoded Decimal for precision)

equity_cross_usdt.description: Cross margin equity in USDT (string-encoded Decimal for precision)

equity_ts.description: Timestamp when equity was calculated in milliseconds

realized_pnl.description: Total realized profit and loss in USD (string-encoded Decimal for precision)

unrealized_pnl.description: Current unrealized profit and loss in USD (string-encoded Decimal for precision). Calculated as sum((mark_price - entry_price) * quantity) for all positions.

available_balance.description: Available balance for new positions in USD (string-encoded Decimal for precision)

open_positions_usd.description: Total notional value of open positions in USD (string-encoded Decimal for precision). EXP-FIX: Used by exposure gate.

open_positions_margin_usd.description: Total margin used by open positions in USD (string-encoded Decimal for precision). EXP-LEVERAGE-001: Margin-based exposure.

positions_by_side.description: EXP-DIRECTION: Per-side margin for directional ratio checks

long_margin.description: Total margin used by long positions in USD (string-encoded Decimal)

short_margin.description: Total margin used by short positions in USD (string-encoded Decimal)

positions_last_ts_ms.description: Timestamp of last position update in milliseconds. EXP-FIX: Used by AuroraBridge freshness gate to prevent race conditions.

net_position.description: Net position quantity (positive = long, negative = short) (string-encoded Decimal for precision)

avg_entry_price.description: Average entry price for the position (string-encoded Decimal for precision)

venues.description: List of venues where this position has exposure
